description: In-silico tryptic digest to test whether bottom-up proteomics can distinguish the 90%-identical tandem paralogs
code:
import re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seqs={}
for line in open("artifacts/gdsl_family.fasta"):
    if line.startswith(">"): lab=line[1:].strip(); seqs[lab]=""
    else: seqs[lab]+=line.strip()
A=[v for k,v in seqs.items() if "AT5G03810" in k][0]
B=[v for k,v in seqs.items() if "AT5G03820" in k][0]
others={k.split("|")[1]:v for k,v in seqs.items()}
def digest(s,missed=1,lo=6,hi=40):
    sites=[0]+[i+1 for i in range(len(s)-1) if s[i] in "KR" and s[i+1]!="P"]+[len(s)]
    peps=set()
    for i in range(len(sites)-1):
        for m in range(0,missed+1):
            if i+1+m<len(sites):
                p=s[sites[i]:sites[i+1+m]]
                if lo<=len(p)<=hi: peps.add(p)
    return peps
pA=digest(A); pB=digest(B)
# mature protein only (after predicted signal peptide, ~res 25)
pAm=digest(A[25:]); pBm=digest(B[25:])
allother=set()
for L,s in others.items():
    if L in ("AT5G03810","AT5G03820"): continue
    allother|=digest(s)
uniqA=pA-pB-allother; uniqB=pB-pA-allother; shared=pA&pB
print("=== in-silico tryptic digest (<=1 missed cleavage, 6-40 aa) ===")
print(f"AT5G03810 peptides: {len(pA)} | AT5G03820 peptides: {len(pB)} | shared between the pair: {len(shared)} ({100*len(shared)/len(pA):.0f}% of AT5G03810 peptides)")
print(f"peptides unique to AT5G03810 (not in AT5G03820 nor any of the other 107 GDSLs): {len(uniqA)}")
print(f"peptides unique to AT5G03820: {len(uniqB)}")
print("\nunique AT5G03810 peptides (proteotypic candidates):")
for p in sorted(uniqA,key=len): print("   ",p, f"({len(p)} aa)")
# coverage attributable uniquely
covA=np.zeros(len(A),dtype=bool)
for p in uniqA:
    for m in re.finditer("(?="+p+")",A): covA[m.start():m.start()+len(p)]=True
covB=np.zeros(len(B),dtype=bool)
for p in uniqB:
    for m in re.finditer("(?="+p+")",B): covB[m.start():m.start()+len(p)]=True
print(f"\nsequence coverage reachable by proteotypic peptides: AT5G03810 {100*covA.mean():.1f}%, AT5G03820 {100*covB.mean():.1f}%")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,2.8))
ax.broken_barh([(i,1) for i in np.where(covA)[0]],(1.1,0.7),facecolors="#d1495b")
ax.broken_barh([(i,1) for i in np.where(covB)[0]],(0.1,0.7),facecolors="#2a9d8f")
ax.set_yticks([1.45,0.45]); ax.set_yticklabels(["AT5G03810","AT5G03820"])
ax.set_xlim(0,360); ax.set_xlabel("residue")
ax.set_title("Regions covered by proteotypic tryptic peptides (unique within the 109-member GDSL family)")
for r_,l_ in [(37,"S37"),(328,"D328"),(331,"H331")]: ax.axvline(r_,color="k",ls=":",lw=1)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(dict(peptide=sorted(uniqA))).to_csv("artifacts/proteotypic_AT5G03810.csv",index=False)
pd.DataFrame(dict(peptide=sorted(uniqB))).to_csv("artifacts/proteotypic_AT5G03820.csv",index=False)
